title: A field goal that never happened
summary: Washington reached field-goal territory in overtime, then ran out of time without attempting a kick. The Giants escaped with a 27–27 tie.

timeline.label: Overtime
timeline.text: Both teams failed to score on their first possessions.

timeline.label: About 50 seconds left
timeline.text: Washington faced second-and-8 at the Giants’ 24. Neither team had a timeout.

timeline.label: 12 seconds left
timeline.text: Jayden Daniels took the snap and went down with about eight seconds remaining.

timeline.label: Clock expires
timeline.text: Washington could not organize another snap. No winning field goal was attempted.

unusual: The offense had already reached a plausible kicking position. The remaining task was preserving an opportunity to attempt the kick, not necessarily gaining more yards.
explanations: Poor communication and clock awareness are supported explanations. A possible field goal was an opportunity, not a guaranteed win.
questions: What specific instruction reached the quarterback before the final snap?
